{{Quote|There's bad news and good news. The bad news is that we're the Hawk-bats, and we're going to take your starfighters and blow up some ground facilities with them. But the good, news is that we really do have fresh caf for you in the mess.|Kell Tainer to Milzin Veyn's wingman|<ref name="IF" />}}
[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Milzin Veyn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]]. Veyn and his [[Milzin Veyn's wingman|wingman]] were assigned as the escort of the refueling [[Tanker/Legends|tanker]] [[Bastion (tanker)|Bastion's]] but were captured then detained by members of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Wraith Squadron]], who at that time were posing as the [[Hawk-bat Independent Space Force]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group.<ref name="IF" />

He was a native of the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Hullis]], and [[Marriage/Legends|married]] with three kids.<ref name="IF" />
